name: Green River — Fontenelle Dam to Green River city
gaugeName: Green River Below Fontenelle Reservoir, WY (USGS 09211200)
blurb: Green River: sections between Wyoming Game and Fish Department river access points.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Fontenelle Dam (Green): exact agency facility pin. Take-out Weeping Rock (Green): exact agency facility pin. Wyoming: next to private land the streambed is private — no anchoring, wading or getting out without landowner permission; floating through is legal. Watercraft entering Wyoming Mar 1–Nov 30 need an AIS inspection. Mileage: approximate distance published in the WGFD Middle Green River Access Map.

notices.title: Diversions below James Town
notices.text: The agency guide advises exiting at James Town rather than navigating the hazards downstream at river miles 67–70. A mapped public ramp does not establish a safe route through this reach.
